text:
rowan-partners: Quick sync — starting the cloud marketplace onboarding for AWS/GCP/Azure. Main deliverables: publisher staging account, offer SKU table, region image verification, marketing copy + legal clearance, and trial config. Who takes what?

caitlin-pm: I can draft the offer SKU table (columns: offer_sku, public_name, internal_id, plan, trial_days, monthly_quota, co_brand_flag). will push a sheet by EOD and include sample customer-facing lines.

ben-sales: i'll confirm starter pack names and trial lengths with GTM. recommending: Starter (10k tokens/mo), Trial-14, Growth, Enterprise. will post final names. :+1:

mohit-legal: i'll own legal checklist and marketing redlines. need to see the product blurbs and any partner logos early. note: no compliance claims (HIPAA/PCI) in listing without contracts. ETA 2 business days after copy lands.

infra-bot: staging-account created: cloud-marketplace-staging (acct 987654321). attach publisher-role to proceed.

rowan-partners: Tess, can infra team produce per-region image verification and a simple fallback plan if replication is delayed?

tess-eng: yes. i'll build a small verifier and a JSON manifest with region->image mapping + replicated_at timestamp. will also output a fallback_image field.

rowan-partners: sample verify command would be helpful for partners.

tess-eng: dropping quick AWS/GCP checks: ```bash
# AWS check
aws ec2 describe-images --region us-east-1 --image-ids $AMI_ID || echo "missing $AMI_ID in us-east-1"
# GCP check
gcloud compute images describe $IMAGE_NAME --project $PROJECT --quiet || echo "$IMAGE_NAME missing"
```

rowan-partners: perfect. include EU/AP checks too. also note any region where we must use a snapshot rather than public image.

tess-eng: will do. plan: run checks across (us-east-1, us-west-2, eu-west-1, eu-central-1, ap-southeast-1). output structure like: region,image_id,replicated_at,fallback_image.

mohit-legal: for the listing text, please avoid "guarantee" language. use "designed to" or "optimized for". also include links to our privacy page and SOC2 summary.

caitlin-pm: noted. i'll write copy with that tone and link placeholders.

rowan-partners: infra question: do we need separate CloudFormation/Terraform snippets for publisher role? keep them minimal.

tess-eng: yes, minimal IAM role. sample TF snippet: ```hcl
resource "aws_iam_role" "marketplace_publisher" {
  name = "redwood-marketplace-publisher-staging"
  assume_role_policy = data.aws_iam_policy_document.assume.json
}
```

infra-bot: Reminder: attach publisher-role to cloud-marketplace-staging before running publish dry-run.

ben-sales: small note re: co-branding: if we include partner logos, partner legal will need to sign off. flag those SKUs early.

caitlin-pm: caitlin -> added a `co_brand_required` column to the sheet. will mark samples.

doc-maintainer: i'll create a short quickstart doc for marketplace publish (console + CLI + terraform) once we have the manifest and SKU table. will include a known-issues section about image replication delays.

rowan-partners: timeline proposal: Day0 assign owners (today), Day1 SKU table + manifest draft, Day2 legal redlines, Day3 staging dry-run, Day4 review and go/no-go. any objections?

mohit-legal: sounds fine. if partner legal is involved it might shift +2 days.

tess-eng: running verification now; will post CSV output to the sheet.

(25m later)

tess-eng: verification results pasted:
- us-east-1: ami-0a1b2c3d replicated_at=2026-03-21T15:10:00Z
- us-west-2: ami-0b2c3d4e replicated_at=2026-03-21T15:12:00Z
- eu-west-1: replication pending (ETA 60m)
- ap-southeast-1: missing -> fallback set to ami-0fallback123

rowan-partners: thanks. noted fallbacks. caitlin/ben/mohit: once copy is ready i'll drop links here for legal redline and sales naming confirmation.

infra-bot: Dry-run checklist: publisher-role attached, manifest.json uploaded to staging, SKU table linked. Run dry-run with --dry-run flag to validate fields.

rowan-partners: Great kickoff. Next quick check-in tomorrow 10:00am. If anyone finds other blockers post them here. :rocket:
